README.md
# Processed grid-level data for bird-related sentiment and environmental variables in Shanghai, 2022–2024

This repository contains processed and anonymized data prepared to support the manuscript entitled "Spatial patterns of the bird-related sentiment index and its nonlinear environmental associations: Evidence from social media and explainable machine learning".

## Files

- `processed_grid_sentiment_environment_data.csv`: final 500 m × 500 m occupied-grid analytical dataset. It includes 1280 grid cells with at least one valid spatially matched bird-related Weibo comment, the grid-level bird-related sentiment index, comment counts, and grid-level environmental variables.
- `grid_sentiment_summary_2022_2024.csv`: cleaned grid-level sentiment summary derived from the ArcGIS spatial join and summary statistics. The unmatched row with blank `grid_id` was excluded.
- `grid_id_reference.csv`: reference information for occupied grid cells, including grid ID, district, town/subdistrict name, grid area, and comment count.
- `anonymized_comment_sentiment_scores.csv`: anonymized comment-level sentiment scores containing only sequential comment IDs, posting year, and model-generated sentiment scores. This file does not contain raw text, user identifiers, Weibo IDs, exact coordinates, precise timestamps, post URLs, or profile information.
- `metadata_data_dictionary.csv`: variable definitions, units, data sources, and processing descriptions.
- `public_data_sources.csv`: links and descriptions for publicly available environmental and spatial datasets.

## Spatial matching summary

The original cleaned dataset contained 4,142 valid bird-related Weibo check-in comments from 2022 to 2024. Among them, 4,011 comments were successfully assigned to the 500 m × 500 m grid system. The remaining 131 comments were not included in grid-based statistics because they did not match the final analytical grid after boundary and water-area processing. The final occupied-grid dataset contains 1280 grid cells.

## Data restrictions

Raw Weibo data are not included because they are subject to Weibo platform terms of service and may contain potentially identifiable user-generated information. The original post text, user identifiers, Weibo IDs, exact geotagged coordinates, precise timestamps, user profile information, and post URLs have been excluded.

The shared grid-level dataset is aggregated and processed for analysis and does not contain raw user-level text records.

## Code availability

This repository contains processed/anonymized data and metadata only. Analysis code is not included in this data deposit.

README.md
Dataset: Air Quality Dataset for Shanghai

Dataset: Air Quality Dataset for Shanghai provides historical air quality time series for Shanghai. It includes city metadata such as coordinates, administrative areas, and population. You can use this dataset to track long-run air quality changes, compare Shanghai with other cities, and create city-level models using air quality signals.

Files included:
- city_info.csv contains identifiers, coordinates, and population.
- air_quality_historical.csv contains the historical time series.
